results.question: What is the logical qubit count and error threshold of the Aurora-7 processor?
results.answer: According to the source documents, In March 2026, Helios Labs announced the deployment of the Aurora-7 quantum processor. The system features 256 logical qubits with a fault-tolerant error threshold of 99.98%.  [quantum_computing_report.md]

results.question: At what temperature does the cooling apparatus operate and what refrigerant is used?
results.answer: According to the source documents, The cooling apparatus operates at 15 millikelvin using a closed-loop helium-3 dilution refrigerator.  [quantum_computing_report.md]

results.question: How much was invested in the project and what are the projected Q4 operating margins?
results.answer: According to the source documents, Helios Labs invested $420 million over four years into the project. Operating margins for the quantum cloud platform are projected to reach 34% by Q4 2026.  [quantum_computing_report.md]
